ruleDefinitions.name: New Remote Desktop Connection Initiated Via Mstsc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the usage of "mstsc.exe" with the "/v" flag to initiate a connection to a remote server.
Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mstsc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "mstsc\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/v\\:.*")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\lxss\\wslhost\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\WSL\\\\wslg\\\.rdp.*")))
